executive_summary: NYFed SPD original modal policy path -> original V5.1 standardized UST location error; source-only pre-outcome freeze.
availability: original publication date 23:59:59 America/New_York; previous origin weekday 16:00 NY cutoff
origins: first existing frozen cache-ledger origin each calendar month; source_calendar.csv fixed before labels
CV: Separate asset,horizon,annual expanding Ridge; target_end and origin+horizon both strictly before first test cutoff; remove all test-active release IDs from training; mechanically skip unfit early folds
standardization: Train-only StandardScaler with same sample weights as Ridge; constant columns deterministically scale1
release_weights: each active training release total weight1; row weight1/count within asset-horizon-fold
pure_location_shift: frozen draws + predicted delta * original frozen SD; preserve shape/scale/order up to floating point precision
scoring: Exact qfbench2-common v2.4.3 fair CRPS; primary2Y+5Y normalized same frozen past SD*sqrtH; ratio of sums, original V5.1 bytes unchanged.
oracle: translate original median to truth; no shape change; descriptive only

controls.value_shuffle: Four policy coordinates among training releases; original test values, age retained
controls.date_permutation: Permute nonnegative0..20 business-day activation delays; no early publication; reconstruct latest states/age/release weights/purge; missing or insufficient training ->zero shift on fixed test ledger
controls.revision_sign: Training release revision values permuted and balanced signs; test values untouched
controls.path_orientation: Balanced training-release signs jointly near/far/slope/revision; age unchanged
controls.one_release_lag: Immediately preceding public SPD state; actual age<=70, missing ->zero shift
controls.year_shift: State one calendar year earlier, missing ->zero shift
controls.Gaussian: Five reproducible Gaussian coordinates per release, same across assets/horizons; same weights/CV
mutations: future source features/fixed fitted predictions bitwise invariant
outcome-side mutation features invariant, no refit invariance claim

concentration: Paired score deletion by release/year; top1/top3 positive gain shares. Removal of one event flipping ratio>=1, or one event>50% positive gain, disallows robust YES; stricter >half-net-gain audit also reported.

success_criteria.STRONG_YES: ratio<=.90,capture>=.20,>=75% annual folds improve, clear controls, release upper95CI<1, no concentration
success_criteria.YES: ratio<=.95,capture>=.10,>=60% folds improve, controls inferior, no severe concentration
success_criteria.WEAK_YES: ratio<=.98,capture>.05,more folds improve, controls generally inferior
success_criteria.NO: meaningful degradation>=1.02 OR capture<=0 OR null controls comparable/better
success_criteria.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise, near baseline/wide intervals/fold conflict/concentration; no redesign

public_private_firewall: Public prediction/provenance/aggregate artifacts; actual labels and individual scores private
batch_null_solver: identical weighted standardized Ridge normal equation; pre-PRE synthetic comparison to sklearn max8.881784197001252e-16; no alternative model
PIT: B; official originals + public post-actual-minutes rule; no immutable historical byte claim
publication_rule: One conservative NYFed/US-Federal-holiday business day after actual FOMC minutes publication; explicit original release evidence where available; date-only activation23:59:59NY
policy_target_rule: Near earliest target strictly after results publication; far latest distinct target within180 calendar days; chosen at release and fixed between releases, no origin redefinition
revision_rule: Current near minus immediately preceding public SPD round for exactly same target date; no crossing target rollover, no missing imputation
panel_rule: SPD only, no combined average, no SMP fallback, latest incomplete state inactive, no older SPD fallback
source_history_admission: Canonical own-mode midpoint direct median starts2016-March; earlier split upper/lower medians excluded before outcomes; first complete revision state2016-April
